x: We scored our only win of the meeting in the 1 Mile with Derrick Burfitt beating Morley of Southgate in quite good time, and as the latter had beaten Derrick the previous Wednesday when running for the A.A.A. against London University, this win gave our runner the chance to turn the tables on his opponent.
Chas Walker ran a good race on the next stage to take us up into 2nd place and was only 1 second slower that Morley of Blackheath who were still in the lead.
